findings: Proposed facility definition covers buildings, constructed/expanded/acquired/remodeled at one or multiple sites, housing high-tech computer systems and equipment.
Proposed industrial-machinery definition includes mobile data centers, equipment and related services used by qualified data centers.

Qualified-facility text specifies investment in excess of $100m, at least15 net new full-time data-center jobs, wages at least150% of state average occupational wage, and best-interest determinations. No comparison to the prior statutory baseline establishes tightening.

March10 9–0 vote is a recommendation for passage with amendments and referral. April20 remains the last displayed Senate calendar action. The refreshed history does not establish final SA0665 adoption.
